label: Round 3: fresh median of three full uncapped runs
sourceDiff: none for gateway/full runs; contention uses identical additional count-print instrumentation saved in artifacts, restored afterwards
method: Three sequential foreground full uncapped runs, 20s after 3s warmup; gateway 0-3, upstream 4-5, oha 6-7; release fat LTO, one codegen unit, panic=abort, mimalloc. OMNI_BENCH=1; coherent epoch-prefix barrier deltas, then request-row accounting. No --rate. Each numeric summary leaf independently median/min/max, not a representative run.

contention.method: Same current writer_throughput eight-producer test copied into git archive c50977ff (pre-round2, no blocking RwLock), both taskset 0-3. 8 spin-paced 125us producers, v4-shaped Begin-only rows, 5s nominal; XBARRIERS unset or 1. Added count-only print after writer.close; original test and instrumented source retained. No XFLOOD. Not the gateway v7 Begin/Finish workload. writtenPerProducerSecond includes subsequent drain counts but excludes drain duration, NOT end-to-end commit capacity.
